parts: 有没有什么免费音频转文字的工具
我会按“真正免费/本地离线/网页省事/中文效果”几个场景来分，避免只给一堆名字。

queries: free audio transcription tools Whisper WebUI Buzz Vibe Transcriber 2026
OpenAI Whisper GitHub free speech recognition local
free online audio transcription tool Chinese

parts:
有，按你的用途我建议这样选：

| 场景 | 推荐工具 | 特点 |
|---|---|---|
| **想完全免费、隐私好** | **Whisper 本地版** | 开源免费，中文可用，音频不上传；但需要本地配置。OpenAI Whisper 本身是开源语音识别模型，支持多语言识别。citeturn908980search0turn908980search4 |
| **电脑配置一般，想跑得快** | **whisper.cpp** | Whisper 的高性能 C/C++ 实现，支持 CPU、本地运行，也支持多种硬件加速。citeturn908980search2 |
| **不想折腾，直接网页上传** | **TurboScribe 免费版** | 网页工具，中文音视频转文字，免费版每天 3 次转写。citeturn908980search10 |
| **短音频临时用** | **WhisperWebUI** | 在线 Whisper 转写，支持 MP3、WAV、M4A、MP4 等，免费版适合短文件。citeturn908980search3 |
| **英文会议/课堂录音** | **Otter.ai 免费版** | 更适合英文会议纪要，免费版有月度分钟限制。citeturn908980news29 |

我的建议很直接：

如果你只是偶尔转录，**先用 TurboScribe 或 WhisperWebUI**，省事。  
如果你经常转录论文访谈、会议录音、隐私音频，**装本地 Whisper / whisper.cpp**，长期最划算。

中文音频的话，优先试：

1. **TurboScribe**
2. **Whisper 本地版**
3. **WhisperWebUI**

不要太迷信“免费在线工具”，很多只是免费试用，长音频、批量导出、说话人分离通常会收费。

items.title: Otter.ai App Adds French and Spanish Transcription: What You Need to Know
items.snippet: Otter.ai has expanded its transcription services to include French and Spanish, alongside English. Users can select their preferred language for real-time recording and transcription using the Otter.ai mobile app, which is available for both Android and iOS. The service can also transcribe conversations during virtual meetings on platforms like Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet. However, it does not offer translation between languages, so the chosen default language must be understood by the user. The app offers a free subscription with 300 transcription minutes per month and up to three imports of audio or video files for transcription. Paid subscriptions, such as the Pro plan, provide more transcription minutes and higher import limits, with tiered pricing up to Enterprise levels for larger needs.
